description: Off-chain-signed payment channel rail on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.31.1). open_channel and close_channel were verified: 2_000_000 lab tokens were locked, a close without an Ed25519 pre-instruction was rejected (MissingEd25519Instruction), and a payer-signed check paid the payee exactly 1_000_000, refunded 1_000_000, and closed the channel and escrow ATA.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of otomat-fun/otomat. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/otomat. The lab changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program. The hosted IDL is the lab build. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (open_channel, close_channel with an Ed25519 check)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/otomat/
QA: devnet proof of cooperative close and MissingEd25519Instruction rejection
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)
dispute_channel, resolve_dispute, timeout_reclaim, commit_receipt, and facilitator bonds

assignments.title: Exercise timeout_reclaim after expiry and a facilitator-bond slash path
